title: Interop day: cross-hub delivery both ways, no 422
description: When Haven delivers messages and Commits from rooms on other hubs: (1) a message in a mimid-hosted room (e.g. r/jkrmqxz3vsjhpttq525lr5iexa with erin) reaches erin on Haven, and Haven's /notify answers 201 with the message actually queued, not 422 (today: 422 'remote-room-not-delivered', mimid drops it: fanout_delivery_refused); (2) a message and a Commit in a Haven-hosted room reach a mimid user through mimid's /notify and appear over JMAP. Ask Jason how he confirms delivery on his side.
notes: The hub's fanout write path changes before this runs: catch-up adds a monotonic per-room sequence, assigned in the same transaction that records the fanout (mimid-1wgh.37.104.1), carried as an additive envelope field beside FanoutMessage (decision mimid-1wgh.104). Haven ignores what it does not know, so the wire change should cost this check nothing -- but if cross-hub delivery regresses here, suspect that transaction first. Mark decided on 2026-11-22 (mimid-1wgh.106) to ship catch-up fully live before this day.
